items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: and for awhile, Sammy Lowe was with me. You know, he was playing trumpet too, and myself.

ctx.x: Well, I was trying to recall the first year. The big band, I think it was as I said in the '50's when the small group, I had—I was down to Bobby Smith and Julian Dash on sax, Ace Harris at piano, Sonny Payne was on drums, Lee Stanfield was on bass, and for awhile, Sammy Lowe was with me. You know, he was playing trumpet too, and myself. I think that was the, that was around, that was the first group.
And then, I made it, I had a couple of changes. Let me see. Norris Turney. I Mercer Ellington now, think he's playing with (unintelligible) first alto.
